dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、起きてください」
ゆらゆらと、身体が揺れる。
dialogues.en: I felt my body being shaken.
dialogues.text: I felt my body being shaken.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほらっ、起きてってば」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ……まだ目覚ましは鳴ってないだろう
　……」
dialogues.en: "What is it......? The alarm hasn't gone off yet, has it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it......? The alarm hasn't gone off yet, has it?"

dialogues.jp:
震度４あたりに到達したところで、うっすらと
目を開ける。
dialogues.en: I slowly opened my eyes as she shook me vigorously.
dialogues.text: I slowly opened my eyes as she shook me vigorously.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「設定時間が遅すぎます。ほら、起きた起きた」
dialogues.en:
"You're setting it too late. It's time for you to wake up
now!"
dialogues.text:
"You're setting it too late. It's time for you to wake up
now!"

dialogues.jp: グラグラと再び揺れ始める。
dialogues.en: She continued to shake my body.
dialogues.text: She continued to shake my body.

dialogues.jp: 「分かったからやめれ」
dialogues.en: "I got it. Will you stop that?"
dialogues.text: "I got it. Will you stop that?"

dialogues.jp: 揺れが収まるとともに、上体を起こす。
dialogues.en: I woke up as she stopped shaking me.
dialogues.text: I woke up as she stopped shaking me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「早く起きてね」

最後に強烈な笑みを残し、音夢が部屋から出て
行った。
dialogues.en: She gave a phony smile and left my room.
dialogues.text: She gave a phony smile and left my room.

dialogues.jp: 「……着替えるか」
ベッドから下り、制服に腕を通す。
dialogues.en: I got off my bed and started putting on my uniform.
dialogues.text: I got off my bed and started putting on my uniform.

dialogues.jp: 「今日で卒業か……」
なんとはなしに呟き、１階に下りた。
◆卒業の朝◆

卒業の朝。久しぶりに音夢に起こされてしまっ
た。
dialogues.en:
It's the morning of the graduation. It's been a while since
the last time Nemu woke me up.
dialogues.text:
It's the morning of the graduation. It's been a while since
the last time Nemu woke me up.
